notice: Candidate assessment definitions for the Grade 1 rules, rights and duties pilot. Unreviewed and unreleased: nothing scores them, writes mastery from them or releases them. For Grade 1 every mastery task is oral or performed and recorded by the teacher; reading and writing are not assessed here. Keys and rubrics are reviewer and teacher only.

tasks.prompt: Fatu walked to the market with her mother. Who went with Fatu?
tasks.fallbackRoute: Retell the story with two children acting it out, then ask who and what again; keep sentences very short for children who still struggle.

tasks.prompt: Where do children go to learn to read?
tasks.fallbackRoute: Show or draw home, school and market; children name each place and one thing people do there before the rules scene.

tasks.prompt: One at a time: 'Show me a rule we follow at school or at home, then tell me why we have it.' The child acts it out and explains; the teacher records.

rubric.criterion: Names or shows a real rule
levels: 0: no rule or a made-up punishment
1: a real home or school rule shown or said
0: 'so we are not beaten' or no reason
1: a reason about safety, health or fairness

tasks.prompt: The teacher shows four picture cards (going to school, sweeping the classroom, being safe, listening to a friend). The child sorts them into right or duty and says one of each aloud.

levels: 2: all four correct (rights: school, safe; duties: sweeping, listening)
1: one right and one duty said correctly

tasks.prompt: Oral: 'Kollie walks near the road only when the teacher is watching. Is that good? Why?' The teacher records the child's words.

levels: 1: the road is dangerous all the time / the rule keeps him safe

tasks.note: Reasoning at Grade 1 is spoken, short and teacher-recorded.

tasks.prompt: One week later, oral: 'Tell me one rule and how it helps us.'

levels: 2: a rule and a safety, health or fairness reason

tasks.prompt: One week later, oral: 'Is keeping the classroom clean a right or a duty?'
Oral, new place: 'At the market, many people want to buy from one seller. What rule could help, and why?'

levels: 1: e.g. wait in line / take turns

tasks.note: New context (the market) not rehearsed in the lesson.

tasks.prompt: Optional: with a partner, make up one new class rule and draw a picture that shows why it helps.
